name: Immich photo
description: Show a photo from an Immich library and label it from the Deck
config_help:
Shows a photo served by a small helper in front of an Immich library, fitted to the widget.

**Photo URL:** the helper's photo address. Put `{{width}}` and `{{height}}` in it and they're replaced with the widget's pixel size, e.g. `http://server/deck-photo?w={{width}}&h={{height}}`. Each refresh can bring a different photo.

**Label it:** tap the photo and choose **Label it** to tag the photo on screen in Immich with the label set below. On a photo that already has the label the button reads **Remove label** and takes the tag off again. The helper names the photo in an `X-Immich-Asset` response header and its tags in `X-Immich-Tags` (percent-encoded, comma-separated), and receives the change as a JSON POST (`{"asset": …, "label": …}`, plus `"remove": true` to remove) at the label URL. The button only shows when both the label and the label URL are set.

url.name: Photo URL
url.description: URL the photos are fetched from

refresh_seconds.name: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to fetch the next photo

sizing.name: Sizing
sizing.description: Fit the whole photo (letterboxed), or fill the widget and crop the overflow

label.name: Label
label.description: Tag given to the photo on screen by Label it, e.g. Favourite

label_url.name: Label URL
label_url.description: Where Label it sends the label, e.g. http://server/deck-photo/label
